home.heroTitle: Share a bike ride across Nashik. Split the fuel.
home.heroSubtitle: Connect with fellow verified Nashik commuters heading in your direction. Safe, affordable, non-commercial pillion cost-sharing.
home.feature1Desc: Daily routes connecting College Road, Gangapur Road, Panchavati, Satpur MIDC, Ambad, and Nashik Road Station.
home.feature2Desc: Strictly fuel cost-pooling capped at ₹4/km. Zero commercial markups, no surge pricing, and no commission fees.
home.feature3Desc: Mandatory helmet verification, identity checks, two-way community ratings, and live emergency SOS dispatch.
home.disclaimerText: BlaBlaBikes operates exclusively as a peer-to-peer fuel cost-sharing platform in compliance with Indian Motor Vehicle guidelines. Rides are private arrangements between two citizens. Commercial hiring or taxi operations are strictly prohibited.
